integrity: Finite exhaustive checks are supporting evidence, not the infinite-size proof; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ambient predecessors of full three-phase clocks and primitive three-cycles at the critical half-degree threshold only; it does not classify other periods or transient lengths. Historical priority remains qualified because the original 1993 full text was not accessible. The squared-cycle initial-three-cycle count is explicitly prior work.
title: Critical three-phase excitation clocks have no transient ancestors on even-regular graphs
